x: There was a slightly over the limit wind as John Regis came home in 20.17, again ahead of Trapp and with his French rivals well down but having to give best to a very much in form Fredericks of Namibia who took our man as the straight was approached and went on to clock 19.99.

Fast times cropped up in the next round with 20.08 from Marsh, and then 20.02 from Fredericks in John's race with our man 2nd in 20.16. But if we thought the 2nd round was classy, the semis were stunning.
Grand Prix Final. 200m: (0.0) 1, Fredericks 20.34; 2, Regis 20.34; 3, Johnson 20.41. Fukuoka, Japan, 18 Sep. 200m: 3, J.Regis 20.42.
